name: workbench-launchd-standin
description: Stand-in for the engine in probe 4. engine/src/config.ts hardcodes ENGINE_PORT to 4173 and the spike may not change engine code, so a second real engine on 4174 is impossible. This binds 4174 instead, launched through the exact same node-then-pnpm-then-start argument chain the real plist uses, so the launchd mechanics under test are unchanged.
